Automated update of the gateway model settings files.

Regenerated from the upstream gateway model list by
[`update-model-settings.yml`](https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/main/.github/workflows/update-model-settings.yml)

commit.message:
fix(harness-acp): scope automatic file approvals to the session workspace (#24296)

## Background

Restrictive ACP permission modes currently approve native file
operations by tool kind without checking their locations. Requests for
paths outside the session working directory can therefore be
automatically approved.

## Summary

- Pass the session working directory to the permission controller and
check every declared location before automatically approving file
operations.
- Resolve symlinks and existing ancestors for new files. External,
missing, or unresolvable locations use the existing host approval flow.
- Preserve explicit `allow-all`, native permission-mode mappings, and
host-tool authorization behavior.
- Add filesystem-backed regression coverage, document the approval
boundary, and add a patch changeset.

## Validation

- ACP package test suite: 490 tests passed.
- GitHub Copilot adapter test suite: 56 tests passed.
- ACP and GitHub Copilot builds, including the ACP bridge bundle.
- `pnpm type-check:full`.
- Targeted formatting and lint checks.

## End-to-End Verification

Not run against a live native ACP CLI.

fix(harness-codex): bump bundled Codex CLI to 0.165.0 (#24300)

## Background

The bundled Codex CLI (`@openai/codex` 0.160.1) does not include model
settings for `gpt-6.1-terra`, so Codex does not apply that model's
settings, including `apply_patch`. Version 0.165.0 includes them.

commit.message:
docs: lead AI Gateway routing examples with default fallback behavior (#24319)

Stop teaching a hard provider filter as the default AI Gateway routing
example.

**Why**

Both routing examples on the AI Gateway provider page paired `order`
with `only`. Readers and coding agents copy them as-is, which removes AI
Gateway's cross-provider fallback even when nothing calls for a
restriction.

**Approach**

Docs only, one file
(`content/providers/01-ai-sdk-providers/00-ai-gateway.mdx`):

- The intro to Gateway Provider Options now says default routing already
picks providers by uptime and latency and falls back across providers.
The example shows `order` alone.
- The `only` option description adds that the request fails instead of
falling back when listed providers are unavailable, and points
data-handling and capability needs to `zeroDataRetention`,
`disallowPromptTraining`, and `has`.
- The "combine these options" example pairs `order` with
`zeroDataRetention` instead of `only`.

`only` stays documented and unchanged in behavior.

**Validation**

Docs-only change; no package code touched, so no changeset. Rendered
output can't be previewed locally per `contributing/documentation.md`.

Co-authored-by: roboeve[bot] <311457182+roboeve[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
